Name: Elizaphan, Son of Parnach
Summary: Elizaphan, Son of Parnach was the prince of Zebulun appointed to divide the land of Canaan by inheritance among the tribes.
KeyStory: Elizaphan was named by the LORD, with Eleazar and Joshua, to apportion the promised land to the nine and a half tribes.
LifeLesson: Dividing what God gives takes honest hands.
